library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: This is the legacy javax.validation (Bean Validation 1.0) line: use javax.validation.* imports and validation-api 1.0.0.GA (transitive), not jakarta.validation. The package is org.hibernate.validator in the org.hibernate:hibernate-validator artifact. Do not add a separate javax.xml.bind:jaxb-api jar next to jaxb-runtime 2.3.9, because both supply javax.xml.bind classes. To cover the JAXB/XML reflection paths, include tests with a META-INF/validation.xml (namespace http://jboss.org/xml/ns/javax/validation/configuration) and a constraint-mapping XML (Configuration.addMapping or <constraint-mapping>), plus annotation-based, programmatic (HibernateValidatorConfiguration.addMapping(ConstraintMapping)), custom-constraint, group/group-sequence and message-interpolation tests. slf4j has no binding by default and only prints a NOP warning, so no logging setup is required. jsoup (@SafeHtml), joda-time (@Past/@Future on Joda types) and hibernate-jpa-2.0-api (JPATraversableResolver) are optional pom dependencies; add them only if you deliberately target those features.
risks: JAXB 2.3.x runtime reflection (com.sun.xml.bind.v2 / org.glassfish.jaxb) may need its own Native Image metadata. Keep allowed-packages limited to org.hibernate.validator so it isn't attributed to this library.
The existing org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator metadata (7.x–9.x, jakarta) is a different artifact and namespace and can't be reused directly for 4.2.0.Final.

ValidationXmlParser loads XSD schemas from the jar (META-INF/validation-configuration-1.0.xsd, validation-mapping-1.0.xsd), so resource-include metadata will be needed for the XML paths in Native Image.
